name: Filament
description: Connects an OpenClaw agent to Filament: receives work via a poll_work long-poll and replies through Filament's MCP-over-HTTP agents API.

connectToken.description: Filament connect/MCP token (fmcp_…). A raw string, a ${ENV_VAR} shorthand, or a SecretRef pointing at a secret provider.

mcpUrl.description: Filament MCP agents endpoint (defaults to production; set for staging/local).

pollWaitSeconds.description: How long (seconds) each poll_work long-poll blocks server-side waiting for work (default 30, matching the server default; clamped to 1-60, the server's own max). Kept at or below 60 so an intermediary with a ~60s timeout (e.g. an nginx dev proxy) doesn't cut the connection before the server's own wait completes.

autoAcceptInvites.description: Accept pending loop invites and vouches automatically. Off by default because poll_work does not deliver them and accepting is a policy decision.

inviteSweepSeconds.description: How often (seconds) to sweep for pending loop invites and vouches when autoAcceptInvites is on (default 60, clamped to 10-600).
